items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: He played second trumpet with me, and Love played second trumpet with me.

ctx.x: Russell. Yeah. He lived over the river. He was the first guy musician, that boy then. Yeah. Oh yeah. He was playing with us too. He was playing with us the best with us, and the boy said quick you see. It's alright. He played second trumpet with me, and Love played second trumpet with me.
